{{Quote|That Meatlump Hrath Koo has bothered me for the last time! He comes into my shop and destroys whatever I'm working on. But no more! Because I'm going to pay you to go into that cave and stop him.|[[Teilo Monnro]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />}}
'''Hrath Koo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now I'm finally free from Hrath's menace. Such a relief, I cannot tell you.|Teilo Monnro, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />}}
[[File:HrathKooMustDie-GH.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Hrath Koo attacked by a Dark Jedi.]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Hrath Koo was a member of the technology-hating Meatlumps and was based in a a [[Meatlump Cave|cave]] near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Hrath Koo harassed the businesswoman [[Teilo Monnro]], repeatedly coming into her shop and destroying whatever she was working on. After several of these incidents, Monnro tracked Koo to the Meatlump Cave.<ref name="SWG:HKMD" /> She luckily met spacers who were working as independent agents for the [[Corellian Security Force]] and were investigating a Meatlump attack on the [[Captain/Legends#Civilian use|starship captain]] [[Osto Grissom]]<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery|Corellia}}</ref> The spacers agreed to help her with her problem.<ref name="SWG:HKMD" /> Hrath Koo was attacked by an unidentified [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]<ref name="GH">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Hrath Koo Must Die}}</ref> and killed.<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hrath Koo appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HKMD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hrath Koo was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
